episodeTitle.en: Building a world-class data org | Jessica Lachs (VP of Analytics and Data Science at DoorDash)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造世界级数据组织 | 杰西卡·拉克斯（Jessica Lachs，DoorDash分析与数据科学副总裁）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jessica Lachs is the global head of analytics and data science at DoorDash, where she’s built one of the largest and most respected data organizations in tech. In her more than 10 years at DoorDash, she has served as the first general manager, responsible for launching new markets; the head of business ops and analytics; and the VP of analytics and data science. Previously, Jessica founded GiftSimple, a social gifting startup, and started her career at Lehman Brothers as an investment banking analyst. In our conversation, she shares: • How to structure and scale a high-impact analytics organization
guestBioOfficial.zh:
杰西卡·拉克斯（Jessica Lachs）是DoorDash全球分析与数据科学负责人，她在该公司打造了科技领域规模最大、最受尊敬的数据组织之一。在DoorDash任职的十多年间，她曾担任首位负责新市场拓展的总经理、业务运营与分析部门主管，以及分析与数据科学副总裁。此前，她创立了社交礼品初创公司GiftSimple，并在雷曼兄弟担任投资银行分析师。在对谈中，她分享了：
• 如何构建和扩展高影响力分析组织

title.en: Building a world-class data org | Jessica Lachs (VP of Analytics and Data Science at DoorDash)
title.zh: 打造世界级数据组织 | 杰西卡·拉克斯（Jessica Lachs，DoorDash分析与数据科学副总裁）

summary.en: Jessica makes the case that analytics should be a business-impact function, not a service desk—answering 'what do we do now?' not just 'why?'. She argues for a centralized data org, explains why retention is a terrible metric to goal on (find a short-term measure that drives long-term output), and shares what to look for when hiring data people. The conversation is full of concrete examples of how DoorDash's data team shaped real decisions, plus great stories from the company's scrappy early days.
summary.zh: Jessica 主张分析应当是一个“驱动业务影响”的职能，而非服务台——回答“我们现在该怎么做？”，而不只是“为什么？”。她主张数据团队集中化，解释了为何“留存”是个糟糕的考核指标（应找一个能驱动长期产出的短期指标），并分享了招聘数据人才时看重的点。对话充满了 DoorDash 数据团队如何影响真实决策的具体案例，以及公司草创期的精彩故事。
